papers.title: Tracking-free mean square displacement analysis of molecular dynamics
papers.summary: A protocol for image-derived mean squared displacement analysis, a fluctuation-based technique to quantify the average spatiotemporal dynamics of subcellular structures—such as proteins, organelles and nanoparticles—in living cells
papers.abstract: Here we describe a protocol for image-derived mean squared displacement (iMSD) analysis, a fluctuation-based technique to quantify the average spatiotemporal dynamics of subcellular structures-such as proteins, organelles and nanoparticles-in living cells. Unlike single-particle tracking, which relies on discrete object localization and trajectory reconstruction, iMSD computes the spatiotemporal autocorrelation function of fluorescence intensity fluctuations directly from standard time-lapse image stacks. This approach overcomes single-particle tracking limitations in high-density or low signal-to-noise environments, providing a robust ensemble average without trajectory linking. The protocol details the optimization of image acquisition parameters, the computation of the spatiotemporal correlation function and the Gaussian fitting of the resulting correlation peak variance to derive the iMSD curve. Expected results include the simultaneous extraction of diffusion coefficients, anomalous exponents and confinement dimensions, allowing users to distinguish between Brownian, superdiffusive and confined motion across different temporal scales. The method's temporal dynamic range depends on the imaging modality: standard confocal scanning resolves millisecond-scale dynamics typical of organelles and membrane proteins, whereas camera-based or line-scanning configurations are required to capture fast cytosolic diffusion. Uniquely, the method also yields information on the average size of the moving objects. The complete procedure takes ~4-6 h of active hands-on time for image acquisition and computational analysis. It requires basic experience in fluorescence microscopy and data processing.

papers.llm_research_question_zh: 本文介绍了一种基于图像分析的平均平方位移测量方法。这种技术通过检测细胞内蛋白质、细胞器及纳米粒子等亚细胞结构的动态变化，来量化它们在活细胞中的平均时空运动规律。

papers.llm_pubmed_abstract_zh: 本文描述了一种基于图像分析的平均平方位移测量方法。这种技术通过检测荧光强度的波动，来量化活细胞中蛋白质、细胞器及纳米粒子等亚细胞结构的平均时空运动规律。与依赖离散对象定位与轨迹重建的单颗粒追踪方法不同，iMSD可以直接从标准的时间序列成像数据中计算出荧光强度波动的时空自相关函数。这种方法能够有效克服高密度样本或低信噪比环境对单颗粒追踪技术的限制，无需进行轨迹重建即可获得可靠的平均运动参数。该技术流程包括图像采集参数的优化设置、时空相关函数的计算，以及通过对相关峰值的高斯拟合来最终确定iMSD曲线。通过这一方法，可以同时获取物质的扩散系数、异常扩散指数及运动受限程度等关键参数，从而帮助研究者区分不同时间尺度下的布朗运动、超扩散行为或受限运动模式。该方法的时间分辨率取决于所使用的成像技术：标准共聚焦显微镜能够检测到细胞器或膜蛋白这类结构在毫秒级别上的运动变化，而基于相机或线扫描技术的成像系统则更适合捕捉细胞质中的快速扩散过程。此外，该技术还能提供有关运动物体平均尺寸的信息。整个实验过程大约需要4至6小时的时间，包括图像采集与数据分析环节，因此要求使用者具备基本的荧光显微镜操作经验和数据处理能力。

papers.title: Isolation and lipidomic profiling of neuronal lipid droplets to unveil the lipid landscape of neurodegenerative disorders
papers.summary: This Protocol describes a robust workflow for pharmacological induction, purification and characterization of mature lipid droplets from primary cortical neurons with minimal detected cytosolic membrane carryover
papers.abstract: Recent advances have expanded the role of lipid droplets (LDs) beyond passive lipid storage, implicating their involvement in various metabolic processes across mammalian tissues. Neuronal LDs, whose existence has long been debated, have now been identified in several neural structures, raising questions about their contribution to neurodegenerative disorders. Elucidating the specific chemical makeup of these organelles within neurons is critical for understanding their role in neural pathologies. However, the inherent submicron size and low abundance in neurons have posed challenges in their isolation and physical and biochemical characterization. Here, we present our Protocol that overcomes this obstacle: we blocked neuron-specific triglyceride lipase to enlarge LDs, rendering them amenable to flotation in a sucrose gradient. We further used an improved methodology of lipidomic analysis on the LDs purified from cultured primary neurons, offering insights into their unique lipid composition. This Protocol can be implemented by researchers with basic expertise in neuronal culture, imaging, ultracentrifuge handling and liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry analysis. The complete workflow requires 3-4 weeks, from neuronal culture to lipidomics analysis. Future integration of this method with high-throughput techniques holds promise for uncovering disease-specific alterations in lipid metabolism, providing new avenues for potential therapeutic interventions.

papers.llm_research_question_zh: 最近的科学研究表明，脂滴的功能已超越单纯的脂质储存作用，它们实际上参与了哺乳动物体内多种代谢过程。
llm_highlights_zh: 长期以来，神经元中的脂滴是否存在一直存在争议。如今，在多种神经结构中都发现了这些脂滴，这引发了人们对于它们在神经退行性疾病中的作用机制的进一步探讨。
阐明神经元中这些细胞器的具体化学组成，对于理解它们在神经病理学中的作用至关重要。
然而，这些物质由于具有亚微米级的尺寸且在神经元中的含量极低，因此在对其进行分离以及进行物理和生化特性分析时面临诸多挑战。
papers.llm_rss_summary_zh: 本方案描述了一种高效的工作流程，用于从原代皮质神经元中分离出成熟的脂质滴，并对其进行药理学诱导、纯化及特性分析，同时能够有效减少细胞质膜成分的污染。
papers.llm_pubmed_abstract_zh: 最近的科学研究进一步拓展了脂滴的功能范围，使其不再仅仅局限于被动储存脂质，而是被证实参与了哺乳动物组织中的多种代谢过程。长期以来其存在一直备受争议的神经元脂滴，如今已在多个神经结构中被确认存在，这一发现引发了人们对于它们在神经退行性疾病中作用的探讨。要真正理解这些细胞器在神经病理学中的作用，就必须弄清它们具体的化学组成。然而，由于脂滴的尺寸极小且在神经元中的含量较低，因此对其进行分离以及进行物理和生化分析一直面临诸多挑战。在这里，我们提出了一种能够克服这些障碍的研究方法：通过阻断神经元特异性甘油三酯脂肪酶来增大脂滴的大小，从而使它们能够在蔗糖梯度中通过浮选法被有效分离出来；随后，我们对从培养的原始神经元中纯化出的脂滴采用了改进后的脂质组学分析技术，从而揭示了它们的独特脂质组成。具备基本神经元培养、成像操作、超速离心技术以及液相色谱-质谱分析经验的研究人员都可以使用这一方法。从神经元培养到完成脂质组学分析，整个实验过程大约需要3至4周的时间。未来，如果能够将这种方法与高通量技术相结合，必将有助于揭示疾病状态下脂质代谢发生的特异性变化，为潜在的治疗策略提供新的研究方向。

papers.summary: Tracking animal behaviors accurately in complex natural environments has been difficult. A lightweight, ‘surround-view’ camera system placed on the head of a freely flying hawk, combined with 3D environmental mapping, can reconstruct the predatory bird’s position and its fine body motion and interactions with targets during aerial prey-capture behaviors in outdoor environments

papers.title: Limitations of de novo peptide sequencing in resolving sequence ambiguity
papers.summary: A benchmark of eight deep learning tools that sequence peptides directly from mass spectra (de novo) shows that their errors mostly stem from incomplete spectra, not model design, calling for tools that flag uncertain regions instead of guessing full sequences
papers.abstract: De novo peptide sequencing enables peptide identification from fragmentation spectra without relying on sequence databases. However, incomplete spectra create ambiguity, making unambiguous identification challenging. Recent deep learning advances have produced numerous de novo models that predict sequences and refine peptide-spectrum matches under such conditions. Yet, their relative strengths, weaknesses and ability to handle spectrum ambiguity remain unclear. Here we benchmark eight state-of-the-art models on three publicly available proteomics datasets, comparing performance using established metrics and quantifying inter-model agreement. We assess post-processing approaches, including iterative refinement, rescoring and reranking, for their ability to improve identification accuracy, and perform an error analysis to identify common mispredictions and their causes. Model performance varied, with considerable overlap of correct identifications. Post-processing yielded no or only modest improvements. Most sequencing errors were model-independent and driven by limited fragment ion coverage, a limitation also observed in database searches with large search spaces.

papers.title: Head-mounted camera for reconstructing outdoor behavior in freely flying birds
papers.summary: A head-mounted camera in combination with drone-based mapping of the environment allows reconstruction of the flight trajectory and behavior such as prey capture in freely flying birds such as the Harris’s hawk
papers.abstract: Capturing the fine details of behavior when animals perform complex tasks, such as prey pursuit and capture, in natural environments is a challenging endeavor. For birds of prey, commonly used tracking approaches, such as lightweight GPS and inertial measurement units, cannot simultaneously track the bird's position and the fine details of body part motion or moving external objects. Here we designed a head-mounted, tetherless, 4π camera system which, combined with a high-resolution environmental scan, enabled detailed three-dimensional measurement of both head position and orientation in freely flying Harris's hawks (Parabuteo unicinctus) performing aerial pursuit in the wild. This stable head-mounted imaging approach enabled reconstruction of flight trajectories in natural environments, detailed quantification of head motion, optic flow and target position, while the bird tracked and captured airborne targets.

papers.llm_research_question_zh: 在自然环境中，捕捉动物在执行捕猎等复杂任务时的细微行为表现是一项极具挑战性的任务。

all_papers.title: Tracking-free mean square displacement analysis of molecular dynamics
all_papers.summary: A protocol for image-derived mean squared displacement analysis, a fluctuation-based technique to quantify the average spatiotemporal dynamics of subcellular structures—such as proteins, organelles and nanoparticles—in living cells
all_papers.abstract: Here we describe a protocol for image-derived mean squared displacement (iMSD) analysis, a fluctuation-based technique to quantify the average spatiotemporal dynamics of subcellular structures-such as proteins, organelles and nanoparticles-in living cells. Unlike single-particle tracking, which relies on discrete object localization and trajectory reconstruction, iMSD computes the spatiotemporal autocorrelation function of fluorescence intensity fluctuations directly from standard time-lapse image stacks. This approach overcomes single-particle tracking limitations in high-density or low signal-to-noise environments, providing a robust ensemble average without trajectory linking. The protocol details the optimization of image acquisition parameters, the computation of the spatiotemporal correlation function and the Gaussian fitting of the resulting correlation peak variance to derive the iMSD curve. Expected results include the simultaneous extraction of diffusion coefficients, anomalous exponents and confinement dimensions, allowing users to distinguish between Brownian, superdiffusive and confined motion across different temporal scales. The method's temporal dynamic range depends on the imaging modality: standard confocal scanning resolves millisecond-scale dynamics typical of organelles and membrane proteins, whereas camera-based or line-scanning configurations are required to capture fast cytosolic diffusion. Uniquely, the method also yields information on the average size of the moving objects. The complete procedure takes ~4-6 h of active hands-on time for image acquisition and computational analysis. It requires basic experience in fluorescence microscopy and data processing.

all_papers.llm_research_question_zh: 本文介绍了一种基于图像分析的平均平方位移测量方法。这种技术通过检测细胞内蛋白质、细胞器及纳米粒子等亚细胞结构的动态变化，来量化它们在活细胞中的平均时空运动规律。

这种方法克服了在高密度环境或信噪比较低的情况下单粒子跟踪所面临的局限性，能够在不进行轨迹关联处理的情况下获得稳定、可靠的集合平均结果。
该协议详细阐述了图像采集参数的优化方法、时空相关函数的计算过程，以及如何通过对所得相关峰值的方差进行高斯拟合来生成iMSD曲线。
all_papers.llm_rss_summary_zh: 一种基于图像分析的平均平方位移测定方法，这种通过测量波动来量化活细胞中蛋白质、细胞器及纳米粒子等亚细胞结构平均时空运动规律的技术。
all_papers.llm_pubmed_abstract_zh: 本文描述了一种基于图像分析的平均平方位移测量方法。这种技术通过检测荧光强度的波动，来量化活细胞中蛋白质、细胞器及纳米粒子等亚细胞结构的平均时空运动规律。与依赖离散对象定位与轨迹重建的单颗粒追踪方法不同，iMSD可以直接从标准的时间序列成像数据中计算出荧光强度波动的时空自相关函数。这种方法能够有效克服高密度样本或低信噪比环境对单颗粒追踪技术的限制，无需进行轨迹重建即可获得可靠的平均运动参数。该技术流程包括图像采集参数的优化设置、时空相关函数的计算，以及通过对相关峰值的高斯拟合来最终确定iMSD曲线。通过这一方法，可以同时获取物质的扩散系数、异常扩散指数及运动受限程度等关键参数，从而帮助研究者区分不同时间尺度下的布朗运动、超扩散行为或受限运动模式。该方法的时间分辨率取决于所使用的成像技术：标准共聚焦显微镜能够检测到细胞器或膜蛋白这类结构在毫秒级别上的运动变化，而基于相机或线扫描技术的成像系统则更适合捕捉细胞质中的快速扩散过程。此外，该技术还能提供有关运动物体平均尺寸的信息。整个实验过程大约需要4至6小时的时间，包括图像采集与数据分析环节，因此要求使用者具备基本的荧光显微镜操作经验和数据处理能力。

all_papers.primary_summary_raw: Here we describe a protocol for image-derived mean squared displacement (iMSD) analysis, a fluctuation-based technique to quantify the average spatiotemporal dynamics of subcellular structures-such as proteins, organelles and nanoparticles-in living cells. Unlike single-particle tracking, which relies on discrete object localization and trajectory reconstruction, iMSD computes the spatiotemporal autocorrelation function of fluorescence intensity fluctuations directly from standard time-lapse image stacks. This approach overcomes single-particle tracking limitations in high-density or low signal-to-noise environments, providing a robust ensemble average without trajectory linking. The protocol details the optimization of image acquisition parameters, the computation of the spatiotemporal correlation function and the Gaussian fitting of the resulting correlation peak variance to derive the iMSD curve. Expected results include the simultaneous extraction of diffusion coefficients, anomalous exponents and confinement dimensions, allowing users to distinguish between Brownian, superdiffusive and confined motion across different temporal scales. The method's temporal dynamic range depends on the imaging modality: standard confocal scanning resolves millisecond-scale dynamics typical of organelles and membrane proteins, whereas camera-based or line-scanning configurations are required to capture fast cytosolic diffusion. Uniquely, the method also yields information on the average size of the moving objects. The complete procedure takes ~4-6 h of active hands-on time for image acquisition and computational analysis. It requires basic experience in fluorescence microscopy and data processing.

all_papers.title: Reconstructing a predatory bird’s aerial pursuit behavior in the wild
all_papers.summary: Tracking animal behaviors accurately in complex natural environments has been difficult. A lightweight, ‘surround-view’ camera system placed on the head of a freely flying hawk, combined with 3D environmental mapping, can reconstruct the predatory bird’s position and its fine body motion and interactions with targets during aerial prey-capture behaviors in outdoor environments

all_papers.title: Limitations of de novo peptide sequencing in resolving sequence ambiguity
all_papers.summary: A benchmark of eight deep learning tools that sequence peptides directly from mass spectra (de novo) shows that their errors mostly stem from incomplete spectra, not model design, calling for tools that flag uncertain regions instead of guessing full sequences
all_papers.abstract: De novo peptide sequencing enables peptide identification from fragmentation spectra without relying on sequence databases. However, incomplete spectra create ambiguity, making unambiguous identification challenging. Recent deep learning advances have produced numerous de novo models that predict sequences and refine peptide-spectrum matches under such conditions. Yet, their relative strengths, weaknesses and ability to handle spectrum ambiguity remain unclear. Here we benchmark eight state-of-the-art models on three publicly available proteomics datasets, comparing performance using established metrics and quantifying inter-model agreement. We assess post-processing approaches, including iterative refinement, rescoring and reranking, for their ability to improve identification accuracy, and perform an error analysis to identify common mispredictions and their causes. Model performance varied, with considerable overlap of correct identifications. Post-processing yielded no or only modest improvements. Most sequencing errors were model-independent and driven by limited fragment ion coverage, a limitation also observed in database searches with large search spaces.

all_papers.llm_research_question_zh: 从头肽序列分析技术使得人们能够在不依赖序列数据库的情况下，通过碎片谱来鉴定肽类化合物。
llm_highlights_zh: 然而，不完整的光谱会导致信息模糊，从而使得准确识别变得十分困难。
近期，深度学习的进展催生了众多新型模型，这些模型能够在相应条件下预测序列信息，并精确匹配肽段与光谱数据。
然而，它们各自的优缺点以及处理频谱模糊性的能力目前仍不明确。
all_papers.llm_rss_summary_zh: 对八种能够直接从质谱数据中推断肽序列的深度学习工具进行的评估表明，这些工具产生的错误主要源于不完整的质谱数据，而非模型设计本身的问题。因此，亟需开发那些能够标记出不确定区域的工具，而不是试图猜测出完整的肽序列。
all_papers.llm_pubmed_abstract_zh: 从头肽序列分析技术使得人们能够在不依赖序列数据库的情况下，通过碎片谱数据来识别肽类分子。然而，由于光谱数据的不完整性，这种识别方法常常会遇到模糊性，从而导致难以准确判断肽类的身份。近年来，深度学习技术的进步催生了众多新的从头预测模型，这些模型能够在这类条件下预测肽的序列并提高肽与光谱数据之间的匹配精度。不过，这些模型的优势与劣势究竟如何，以及它们在处理光谱数据模糊性问题时的表现如何，目前仍不明确。因此，我们在三个公开可用的蛋白质组学数据集上对八种最先进的从头预测模型进行了性能评估，通过既定的评价指标比较了它们的识别效果，并量化了各模型之间的差异。我们还研究了包括迭代优化、重新评分和重新排序在内的后处理方法，分析这些方法在提高识别准确性方面的作用，并通过错误分析找出了常见的预测错误及其产生原因。实验结果显示，不同模型的识别结果存在一定程度的重叠，而后处理方法对识别准确性的提升效果有限或几乎没有效果。大多数序列识别错误与所使用的模型本身无关，其根本原因在于碎片离子的覆盖范围不足——这一限制在那些搜索空间较大的数据库查询中也同样存在。

all_papers.title: Isolation and lipidomic profiling of neuronal lipid droplets to unveil the lipid landscape of neurodegenerative disorders
all_papers.summary: This Protocol describes a robust workflow for pharmacological induction, purification and characterization of mature lipid droplets from primary cortical neurons with minimal detected cytosolic membrane carryover
all_papers.abstract: Recent advances have expanded the role of lipid droplets (LDs) beyond passive lipid storage, implicating their involvement in various metabolic processes across mammalian tissues. Neuronal LDs, whose existence has long been debated, have now been identified in several neural structures, raising questions about their contribution to neurodegenerative disorders. Elucidating the specific chemical makeup of these organelles within neurons is critical for understanding their role in neural pathologies. However, the inherent submicron size and low abundance in neurons have posed challenges in their isolation and physical and biochemical characterization. Here, we present our Protocol that overcomes this obstacle: we blocked neuron-specific triglyceride lipase to enlarge LDs, rendering them amenable to flotation in a sucrose gradient. We further used an improved methodology of lipidomic analysis on the LDs purified from cultured primary neurons, offering insights into their unique lipid composition. This Protocol can be implemented by researchers with basic expertise in neuronal culture, imaging, ultracentrifuge handling and liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry analysis. The complete workflow requires 3-4 weeks, from neuronal culture to lipidomics analysis. Future integration of this method with high-throughput techniques holds promise for uncovering disease-specific alterations in lipid metabolism, providing new avenues for potential therapeutic interventions.

all_papers.llm_research_question_zh: 最近的科学研究表明，脂滴的功能已超越单纯的脂质储存作用，它们实际上参与了哺乳动物体内多种代谢过程。
llm_highlights_zh: 长期以来，神经元中的脂滴是否存在一直存在争议。如今，在多种神经结构中都发现了这些脂滴，这引发了人们对于它们在神经退行性疾病中的作用机制的进一步探讨。
阐明神经元中这些细胞器的具体化学组成，对于理解它们在神经病理学中的作用至关重要。

all_papers.primary_summary_raw: Recent advances have expanded the role of lipid droplets (LDs) beyond passive lipid storage, implicating their involvement in various metabolic processes across mammalian tissues. Neuronal LDs, whose existence has long been debated, have now been identified in several neural structures, raising questions about their contribution to neurodegenerative disorders. Elucidating the specific chemical makeup of these organelles within neurons is critical for understanding their role in neural pathologies. However, the inherent submicron size and low abundance in neurons have posed challenges in their isolation and physical and biochemical characterization. Here, we present our Protocol that overcomes this obstacle: we blocked neuron-specific triglyceride lipase to enlarge LDs, rendering them amenable to flotation in a sucrose gradient. We further used an improved methodology of lipidomic analysis on the LDs purified from cultured primary neurons, offering insights into their unique lipid composition. This Protocol can be implemented by researchers with basic expertise in neuronal culture, imaging, ultracentrifuge handling and liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry analysis. The complete workflow requires 3-4 weeks, from neuronal culture to lipidomics analysis. Future integration of this method with high-throughput techniques holds promise for uncovering disease-specific alterations in lipid metabolism, providing new avenues for potential therapeutic interventions.

all_papers.title: Head-mounted camera for reconstructing outdoor behavior in freely flying birds
all_papers.summary: A head-mounted camera in combination with drone-based mapping of the environment allows reconstruction of the flight trajectory and behavior such as prey capture in freely flying birds such as the Harris’s hawk
all_papers.abstract: Capturing the fine details of behavior when animals perform complex tasks, such as prey pursuit and capture, in natural environments is a challenging endeavor. For birds of prey, commonly used tracking approaches, such as lightweight GPS and inertial measurement units, cannot simultaneously track the bird's position and the fine details of body part motion or moving external objects. Here we designed a head-mounted, tetherless, 4π camera system which, combined with a high-resolution environmental scan, enabled detailed three-dimensional measurement of both head position and orientation in freely flying Harris's hawks (Parabuteo unicinctus) performing aerial pursuit in the wild. This stable head-mounted imaging approach enabled reconstruction of flight trajectories in natural environments, detailed quantification of head motion, optic flow and target position, while the bird tracked and captured airborne targets.

all_papers.llm_research_question_zh: 在自然环境中，捕捉动物在执行捕猎等复杂任务时的细微行为表现是一项极具挑战性的任务。
llm_highlights_zh: 对于猛禽而言，目前常用的追踪方法，如轻量级GPS设备及惯性测量单元，无法同时监测鸟类的位置信息以及其身体各部位的运动细节或外部移动物体的情况。
我们设计了一套头戴式、无绳连接的4π相机系统，该系统结合高分辨率的环境扫描技术，能够对在野外进行空中追捕的哈里斯鹰（Parabuteo unicinctus）的头部位置与方向进行精确的三维测量。
这种稳定的头戴式成像技术使得人们能够在自然环境中重建鸟类的飞行轨迹，同时详细量化其头部运动、视觉流信息以及目标的位置；当鸟类追踪并捕捉空中目标时，该技术也能有效地记录这些过程。
all_papers.llm_rss_summary_zh: 通过将头戴式摄像机与基于无人机的环境测绘技术相结合，可以重建诸如哈里斯鹰这类自由飞行的鸟类的飞行轨迹及其捕猎行为。
all_papers.llm_pubmed_abstract_zh: 在自然环境中，捕捉动物执行复杂任务（如追捕猎物）时的细微动作细节是一项极具挑战性的任务。对于猛禽而言，目前常用的追踪方法——例如轻量级的GPS系统和惯性测量单元——无法同时记录鸟类的位置以及其身体各部位的运动细节或外部移动物体的位置信息。因此，我们设计了一种可佩戴在头部、无需连接线缆的4π相机系统。该系统结合高分辨率的环境扫描技术，能够准确测量野生环境中自由飞行的哈里斯鹰在追捕猎物时头部的位置与方向变化。这种稳定的头部成像技术使得人们能够在自然环境中重建这些鸟类的飞行轨迹，并详细量化它们的头部运动方式、视觉流信息以及猎物的位置数据，从而更全面地了解它们捕猎的行为过程。
